create_CHStoneDataset: create a CHStoneDataset instance with a gcc binary path and site data base directory
list_benchmark_uris: list all CHStone benchmark URIs by calling benchmark_uris on a CHStoneDataset instance
get_benchmark_from_uri: get a Benchmark object from a parsed BenchmarkUri using benchmark_from_parsed_uri method
preprocess_c_benchmark: preprocess a C benchmark source file with GCC -E and return the preprocessed Benchmark
check_dataset_size: check the number of benchmarks in the CHStone dataset using the size property
